correctedApproval.english: a boundary, especially one defined by markers or a bank
correctedApproval.context: Rare noun sense. The markers need not be stones; a bank may also define the boundary. Not the separate augmentative adjective based on lindo.
correctedApproval.notes: Markers correctly translates mojones without imposing stone construction. Bank is the physical ribazo/earthen-bank sense in this boundary context, not a financial institution.
